import { CreditCard, TrendingUp, AlertTriangle, Receipt, DollarSign, Sparkles, ArrowUpRight, ArrowDownRight, Activity, Filter, Search, Download, Share2, Plus, Users, ChevronRight, Info, ShieldCheck, Landmark, Settings } from "lucide-react"; import AppHeader from "@/components/AppHeader"; import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"; import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"; import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress"; import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"; import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"; import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query"; import api from "@/lib/api"; import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion"; export default function Finance() { const { data: summary, isLoading: summaryLoading } = useQuery({ queryKey: ["finance-summary"], queryFn: async () => { const res = await api.get("/finance/summary"); return res.data; } }); const { data: payments = [], isLoading: paymentsLoading } = useQuery({ queryKey: ["finance-payments"], queryFn: async () => { const res = await api.get("/finance/payments"); return res.data; } }); return ( <>
{/* Fiscal Highlights */}
TARGET

KES {summaryLoading ? "..." : (summary?.totalInvoiced || 0).toLocaleString()}

Cumulative Invoiced
{summary?.collectionRate}% Collection Flux

KES {summaryLoading ? "..." : (summary?.totalPaid || 0).toLocaleString()}

Acquired Revenue
PENDING

KES {summaryLoading ? "..." : (summary?.totalArrears || 0).toLocaleString()}

Arrears Spectrum
+12.4% MoM Flux

KES 2.45M

Monthly Velocity
{/* Tactical Controls */}
Filter Matrix
{/* Content Engine */}
{/* Payment Stream */}
Recent Ingress Stream

Real-time revenue synchronization

 {paymentsLoading ? (

Accessing Bank Registry...

) : payments.length === 0 ? (

No Recent Transactions Detected

) : ( payments.map((p: any, i: number) => (
{p.invoice?.student?.firstName} {p.invoice?.student?.lastName}

REF: {p.reference} · {new Date(p.date).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' })}

KES {Number(p.amount).toLocaleString()}

SECURE
)) )} {/* Collection Logic Grid */} Cohort Saturation

Fee coverage by structural unit

 {[ { cls: "Secondary Grade 7", pct: 85, color: "bg-primary" }, { cls: "Secondary Grade 8", pct: 72, color: "bg-indigo-500" }, { cls: "Primary Grade 6", pct: 80, color: "bg-emerald-500" }, { cls: "Early Childhood", pct: 91, color: "bg-amber-500" }, ].map((item, idx) => (
{item.cls} {item.pct}% SECURED
))}
Fiscal Insight

Revenue collection is currently trending +5.2% above previous cluster average. Focus on Grade 8 arrears to reach optimal flow.

); }
